body:
INFORMED OPINION — accept CODE RED and the immediate baseline-heuristic / segmentation-conditioned safety label.

One additional source-backed boundary matters before designing the ensemble. HsmmResult.validated requires every posterior row to total 1, and those rows are keyed by resolved RecallUnitId. Downstream estimands do not all normalize the same way: AlignmentMatrix.visitation and RecallSignature leaf visitation use 1 - exp(-sum_i P_iv); source mass, specificity, and compression also consume row sums; other quantities are row means; chronology consumes the n-1 flow transitions. Therefore, replacing one checked unit by two checked child units with identical state distributions mechanically doubles that unit's contribution to column mass and changes visitation, while also changing the transition axis. The two analyses can each be internally valid and still have no row-wise mixture with a declared scientific meaning.

I recommend an R0 adversarial oracle in addition to the two already proposed: construct (A) one checked recall unit and (B) two checked child units covering the same transcript content, give the children the same state distribution as the parent, and demonstrate which published signature/visitation quantities change solely because of the split. This should court the rule that the first sensitivity API returns a family of complete HsmmResult/RecallSignature artifacts, each keyed by its construction receipt. It must not concatenate or average P/F matrices across segmentations. An uncalibrated alternative set supports a range/envelope or labeled sensitivity family, not a posterior-weighted mean. Any later aggregate needs an explicit common base measure (for example transcript-span mass or a named scalar estimand) and a declared crosswalk.

There is a matching coordinate rule for construction proposals. Boundary proposals should bind transcript gaps/spans, and interpretation proposals should bind exact SpanSet evidence independently of RecallUnitId, because the unit IDs only exist after segmentation resolution. Otherwise a split/merge alternative forces the same proposition, entity, or coreference evidence to be duplicated, dropped, or spuriously re-identified. Add a court where one interpretation's evidence crosses a candidate boundary and must survive both the merged and split alternatives without becoming two independent claims.

Finally, PopulationAggregate currently records/checks viewFingerprint and per-subject recallChecksum, but no construction receipt or policy. It should refuse or stratify incompatible construction authorities. Even compatible policies do not make raw unit rows commensurate, so population sensitivity should aggregate declared whole-analysis/source-axis estimands, not posterior rows.

This agrees with the scout correction: recallChecksum is already content/unitization identity; the missing coordinate is construction authority/receipt. No source change, vocabulary claim, reservation, or implementation scope claimed here; ADR/design court first.
